test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: P and Q working alone can complete a work in 12 days and 24 days respectively. They work on alternate days one at a time. P works on the first day. In how many days the whole work will be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

P = 12 days

Q = 24 days

Work alternately, P starts first

**Formula used:**

Work = LCM of days

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

LCM of 12 and 24 = 24

⇒ Total work = 24 units

⇒ P’s 1 day work = 24 ÷ 12 = 2 units

⇒ Q’s 1 day work = 24 ÷ 24 = 1 unit

⇒ In 2 days (P + Q): 2 + 1 = 3 units

⇒ In 16 days (8 cycles): 3 × 8 = 24 units

**∴ Work will be completed in 16 days**
